-- =============================================================================
-- Dataset 14  unattributed_spend       Page 4 Waste               Visual: table (+ counter)
-- Waste item 5: spend without a cost-center tag or an owner tag, per
-- workspace and compute category. This is unmonitored spend, not waste:
-- estimated_waste_usd and the saving are 0; affected_cost_usd is the USD at risk.
--
-- Tag keys as in dataset 09 (case-insensitive, letters and digits only).
--   EDIT HERE if PEST uses other keys: the two arrays in tag_keys below.
--
-- Tables  system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
--         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
-- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
-- =============================================================================
WITH tag_keys AS (
  SELECT
    array('costcenter', 'costcentre')                     AS cost_center_keys,  -- EDIT HERE
    array('owner', 'businessowner', 'technicalowner')     AS owner_keys         -- EDIT HERE
),
priced AS (
  -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
  SELECT
    u.*,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
      * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage AS u
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
    ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
    AND p.cloud = u.cloud
    AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
    AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
    AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT
    p.workspace_id,
    p.list_cost_usd,
    CASE
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE'                                          THEN 'All-purpose compute (classic)'
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product IN ('JOBS', 'DLT') AND COALESCE(p.product_features.is_serverless, FALSE) THEN 'Serverless jobs and pipelines'
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product IN ('JOBS', 'DLT')                                       THEN 'Classic jobs and pipelines'
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'SQL'                                                  THEN 'SQL warehouses'
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'INTERACTIVE'                                          THEN 'Serverless notebooks'
      WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'                                        THEN 'Model serving'
      ELSE concat('Other: ', COALESCE(p.billing_origin_product, 'unknown'))
    END AS compute_category,
    NULLIF(trim(try_element_at(map_values(map_filter(p.custom_tags,
      (k, v) -> array_contains(t.cost_center_keys, lower(regexp_replace(k, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', ''))))), 1)), '') AS cost_center,
    NULLIF(trim(try_element_at(map_values(map_filter(p.custom_tags,
      (k, v) -> array_contains(t.owner_keys, lower(regexp_replace(k, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', ''))))), 1)), '')       AS owner_tag
  FROM priced AS p
  CROSS JOIN tag_keys AS t
),
by_category AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    compute_category,
    SUM(list_cost_usd)                                                              AS cost_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cost_center IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END)                AS no_cost_center_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN owner_tag  IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END)                 AS no_owner_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cost_center IS NULL OR owner_tag IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unattributed_usd
  FROM tagged
  GROUP BY workspace_id, compute_category
)
SELECT
  '5 Unattributed spend (no cost-center or owner tag)'                   AS waste_item,
  b.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name,
           CASE WHEN b.workspace_id IS NULL THEN '(account level)'
                ELSE concat('workspace ', b.workspace_id) END)            AS workspace_name,
  'Usage category'                                                       AS resource_type,
  concat(COALESCE(b.workspace_id, 'account'), ':', b.compute_category)   AS resource_id,
  b.compute_category                                                     AS resource_name,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                   AS owner,
  concat(CAST(ROUND(try_divide(b.no_cost_center_usd, b.cost_usd) * 100, 0) AS STRING), ' % without cost-center tag, ',
         CAST(ROUND(try_divide(b.no_owner_usd, b.cost_usd) * 100, 0) AS STRING), ' % without owner tag')
                                                                         AS finding,
  CASE b.compute_category
    WHEN 'All-purpose compute (classic)'  THEN 'Make tags mandatory in every compute policy: "custom_tags.CostCenter": {"type": "allowlist", "values": [...]} and "custom_tags.Owner": {"type": "unlimited"}'
    WHEN 'Classic jobs and pipelines'     THEN 'Use a job-only compute policy with the same mandatory custom_tags.CostCenter and custom_tags.Owner rules; add job tags'
    WHEN 'Serverless jobs and pipelines'  THEN 'Assign a serverless usage policy with CostCenter and Owner tags to the jobs and pipelines'
    WHEN 'Serverless notebooks'           THEN 'Assign a serverless usage policy with CostCenter and Owner tags to the users or groups'
    WHEN 'SQL warehouses'                 THEN 'Add CostCenter and Owner tags on each SQL warehouse (Edit > Advanced options > Tags)'
    WHEN 'Model serving'                  THEN 'Add CostCenter and Owner tags on each serving endpoint or a serverless usage policy'
    ELSE 'Tag the resource where the product supports tags, or use a serverless usage policy'
  END                                                                    AS recommended_fix,
  ROUND(b.unattributed_usd, 2)                                           AS affected_cost_usd,
  CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS estimated_waste_usd,
  CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
  'Visibility item: no direct saving; enables chargeback and owner follow-up'
                                                                         AS saving_basis,
  ROUND(b.cost_usd, 2)                                                   AS category_cost_usd,
  ROUND(b.no_cost_center_usd, 2)                                         AS no_cost_center_usd,
  ROUND(b.no_owner_usd, 2)                                               AS no_owner_usd
FROM by_category AS b
LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
WHERE b.unattributed_usd > 0
ORDER BY affected_cost_usd DESC;

-- =============================================================================
-- Dataset 15  waste_job_runs           Page 4 Waste               Visual: table (+ counter)
-- Waste item 6: failed or repaired job runs, and long-running job runs, per job.
--
-- Run cost = billing.usage joined on usage_metadata.job_id / job_run_id (Learn:
-- "Calculate cost per job run"). Covers job compute and serverless jobs; jobs
-- on all-purpose compute have no job_run_id in billing (see item 4).
-- Run facts from job_run_timeline (runs over an hour have several rows;
-- result_state is set only on the row that ends the run; a repaired run has
-- more than one row with a result_state - the Learn "retried job runs" pattern).
--   6a Failed or repaired runs:
--      final state FAILED / ERROR / TIMED_OUT -> waste = whole run cost
--      repaired, then SUCCEEDED               -> waste = cost up to the last failure
--   6b Long-running runs (successful, not repaired):
--      run minutes > 2 x the job's median AND at least 30 minutes over it,
--      job with at least 3 such runs          -> waste = run cost - median run cost
-- Monthly saving = period waste x 30 / days in period.
--
-- Tables  system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline, system.lakeflow.jobs (regional),
--         system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
--         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
-- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
-- =============================================================================
WITH priced AS (
  -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
  SELECT
    u.*,
    CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
      * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
  FROM system.billing.usage AS u
  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
    ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
    AND p.cloud = u.cloud
    AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
    AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
    AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
    AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
  WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
),
run_hour_cost AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id AS run_id,
         date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
         SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
         max_by(identity_metadata.run_as, usage_end_time) AS run_as
  FROM priced
  WHERE billing_origin_product = 'JOBS'
    AND usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL AND usage_metadata.job_run_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY workspace_id, usage_metadata.job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id, date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time)
),
runs AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, job_id, run_id,
    SUM(timestampdiff(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) / 60.0                AS run_minutes,
    COUNT(result_state)                                                                   AS terminal_rows,
    max_by(result_state, CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END)     AS final_state,
    max_by(termination_code, CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END) AS final_termination_code,
    MAX(CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN period_end_time END) AS last_failure_end,
    max_by(termination_code,
           CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN period_end_time END) AS failure_termination_code
  FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
  WHERE period_start_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 1) AND period_start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
  GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id
),
run_level AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    c.cost_usd,
    c.cost_until_last_failure_usd,
    c.run_as,
    CASE WHEN r.final_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT')       THEN 'failed'
         WHEN r.final_state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND r.last_failure_end IS NOT NULL THEN 'repaired'
         WHEN r.final_state = 'SUCCEEDED'                              THEN 'succeeded'
         ELSE 'other' END                                               AS outcome
  FROM runs AS r
  JOIN (
    SELECT h.workspace_id, h.job_id, h.run_id,
           SUM(h.cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
           SUM(CASE WHEN h.usage_hour <= date_trunc('HOUR', r2.last_failure_end) THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END)
                                                                        AS cost_until_last_failure_usd,
           max_by(h.run_as, h.usage_hour) AS run_as
    FROM run_hour_cost AS h
    JOIN runs AS r2 ON r2.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND r2.job_id = h.job_id AND r2.run_id = h.run_id
    GROUP BY h.workspace_id, h.job_id, h.run_id
  ) AS c
    ON c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND c.job_id = r.job_id AND c.run_id = r.run_id
),
job_baseline AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id,
         percentile_approx(run_minutes, 0.5) AS median_minutes,
         percentile_approx(cost_usd, 0.5)    AS median_cost_usd,
         COUNT(*)                            AS clean_runs
  FROM run_level
  WHERE outcome = 'succeeded'
  GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id
),
issues AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id, job_id,
    '6a Failed or repaired job runs'                                    AS waste_item,
    COUNT(*)                                                            AS affected_runs,
    SUM(cost_usd)                                                       AS affected_cost_usd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'failed' THEN cost_usd ELSE cost_until_last_failure_usd END) AS waste_usd,
    concat(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' failed, ',
           CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'repaired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' repaired; codes: ',
           COALESCE(array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(failure_termination_code)), 1, 3), ', '), 'n/a'))
                                                                        AS finding,
    'Fix the root cause shown by the termination codes; set task retries with a retry interval, a job timeout and a failure notification (job > Duration and timeouts / Notifications)'
                                                                        AS recommended_fix,
    'Failed run: whole run cost; repaired run: cost up to the last failure'
                                                                        AS saving_basis,
    max_by(run_as, cost_usd)                                            AS run_as
  FROM run_level
  WHERE outcome IN ('failed', 'repaired')
  GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    rl.workspace_id, rl.job_id,
    '6b Long-running job runs',
    COUNT(*),
    SUM(rl.cost_usd),
    SUM(GREATEST(rl.cost_usd - b.median_cost_usd, 0)),
    concat(CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), ' runs over 2x the median of ',
           CAST(ROUND(MAX(b.median_minutes), 0) AS STRING), ' min; longest ',
           CAST(ROUND(MAX(rl.run_minutes), 0) AS STRING), ' min'),
    'Set a job timeout and a duration warning threshold; check data skew, input growth and cluster size',
    'Run cost above the job''s median run cost',
    max_by(rl.run_as, rl.cost_usd)
  FROM run_level AS rl
  JOIN job_baseline AS b ON b.workspace_id = rl.workspace_id AND b.job_id = rl.job_id
  WHERE rl.outcome = 'succeeded'
    AND b.clean_runs >= 3                                      -- EDIT HERE: minimum runs for a baseline
    AND rl.run_minutes > 2 * b.median_minutes                  -- EDIT HERE: x median
    AND rl.run_minutes - b.median_minutes >= 30                -- EDIT HERE: minutes over median
  GROUP BY rl.workspace_id, rl.job_id
),
jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, run_as_user_name, creator_user_name
  FROM (SELECT j.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.workspace_id, j.job_id ORDER BY j.change_time DESC) AS rn
        FROM system.lakeflow.jobs AS j) AS t
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  i.waste_item,
  i.workspace_id,
  COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', i.workspace_id))       AS workspace_name,
  'Job'                                                                  AS resource_type,
  i.job_id                                                               AS resource_id,
  COALESCE(jl.name, i.job_id)                                            AS resource_name,
  COALESCE(jl.run_as_user_name, i.run_as, jl.creator_user_name)          AS owner,
  i.finding,
  i.recommended_fix,
  ROUND(i.affected_cost_usd, 2)                                          AS affected_cost_usd,
  ROUND(i.waste_usd, 2)                                                  AS estimated_waste_usd,
  ROUND(i.waste_usd * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2)  AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
  i.saving_basis,
  i.affected_runs
FROM issues AS i
LEFT JOIN jobs_latest AS jl ON jl.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND jl.job_id = i.job_id
LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
WHERE i.waste_usd > 0
ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC;

-- =============================================================================
-- Dataset 16  recommendations          Page 5 Recommendations     Visual: table + bar + counters
-- GENERATED by build_dashboard.py from datasets 10-15. Do not edit; edit those
-- files and run: python3 tools/databricks/cost_dashboard/build_dashboard.py
--
-- Every waste item with its specific fix and the estimated monthly saving,
-- highest saving first. Each waste dataset puts a cost in exactly one item
-- (item 2 leaves out the resources of items 1 and 3), so the total does not
-- double count. Item 5 (unattributed spend) has no direct saving.
-- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
-- =============================================================================
WITH all_items AS (
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 10  waste_cluster_autotermination  Page 4 Waste   Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 1: all-purpose clusters (cluster_source UI or API) that are not
    -- deleted and have auto-termination off (0 / NULL) or over 60 minutes.
    --
    -- Estimated waste  = list cost of the cluster's IDLE billed hours in the period.
    --   Idle hour      = the busiest node of the cluster averaged under 5 % CPU
    --                    (cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) in that clock hour.
    -- Estimated saving if auto-termination is set to 30 minutes:
    --   setting > 60   : idle cost x (1 - 30 / setting)
    --   setting off    : idle cost minus 30 minutes of cost per active day
    --   (monthly = period saving x 30 / days in period)
    -- Hours with no node_timeline rows are not judged ("Nodes that ran for less
    -- than 10 minutes might not appear in the node_timeline table").
    -- List price only: the Azure VM cost of the same idle hours comes on top.
    --
    -- Tables  system.compute.clusters, system.compute.node_timeline (regional),
    --         system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
    --         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    clusters_latest AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM (SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.workspace_id, c.cluster_id ORDER BY c.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.compute.clusters AS c) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    flagged AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, cluster_name, owned_by,
             COALESCE(auto_termination_minutes, 0) AS autoterm_min
      FROM clusters_latest
      WHERE cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
        AND delete_time IS NULL
        AND (auto_termination_minutes IS NULL OR auto_termination_minutes = 0 OR auto_termination_minutes > 60)
    ),
    cluster_hour_cost AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
             date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
             SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd
      FROM priced
      WHERE billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE' AND usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY workspace_id, usage_metadata.cluster_id, date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time)
    ),
    node_hour AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, instance_id, date_trunc('HOUR', start_time) AS usage_hour,
             AVG(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS node_cpu_pct
      FROM system.compute.node_timeline
      WHERE start_time >= :start_date AND start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
      GROUP BY workspace_id, cluster_id, instance_id, date_trunc('HOUR', start_time)
    ),
    cluster_hour_cpu AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour, MAX(node_cpu_pct) AS max_node_cpu_pct
      FROM node_hour
      GROUP BY workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour
    ),
    hours AS (
      SELECT h.workspace_id, h.cluster_id, h.usage_hour, h.cost_usd,
             c.max_node_cpu_pct < 5 AS is_idle                       -- EDIT HERE: idle CPU threshold (%)
      FROM cluster_hour_cost AS h
      LEFT JOIN cluster_hour_cpu AS c
        ON c.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND c.cluster_id = h.cluster_id AND c.usage_hour = h.usage_hour
    ),
    per_cluster AS (
      SELECT
        f.workspace_id, f.cluster_id, f.cluster_name, f.owned_by, f.autoterm_min,
        COALESCE(SUM(h.cost_usd), 0)                                         AS cost_usd,
        COUNT(h.usage_hour)                                                  AS billed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN h.is_idle THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                           AS idle_hours,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.is_idle THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 0)     AS idle_cost_usd,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.is_idle = FALSE THEN to_date(h.usage_hour) END) AS active_days,
        COALESCE(try_divide(SUM(h.cost_usd), COUNT(h.usage_hour)), 0)        AS avg_hour_cost_usd
      FROM flagged AS f
      LEFT JOIN hours AS h
        ON h.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND h.cluster_id = f.cluster_id
      GROUP BY f.workspace_id, f.cluster_id, f.cluster_name, f.owned_by, f.autoterm_min
    ),
    scored AS (
      SELECT *,
             CASE WHEN autoterm_min > 60 THEN idle_cost_usd * (1 - 30.0 / autoterm_min)
                  ELSE GREATEST(idle_cost_usd - active_days * 0.5 * avg_hour_cost_usd, 0)
             END AS saving_usd
      FROM per_cluster
    )
    SELECT
      '1 Auto-termination off or over 60 min'                                AS waste_item,
      s.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', s.workspace_id))       AS workspace_name,
      'All-purpose cluster'                                                  AS resource_type,
      s.cluster_id                                                           AS resource_id,
      s.cluster_name                                                         AS resource_name,
      s.owned_by                                                             AS owner,
      concat('Auto-termination ',
             CASE WHEN s.autoterm_min = 0 THEN 'off' ELSE concat(CAST(s.autoterm_min AS STRING), ' min') END,
             '; ', CAST(s.idle_hours AS STRING), ' idle of ', CAST(s.billed_hours AS STRING), ' billed hours')
                                                                             AS finding,
      concat('Set auto-termination to 30 min. Enforce it with a compute policy: ',
             '"autotermination_minutes": {"type": "range", "minValue": 10, "maxValue": 60, "defaultValue": 30}')
                                                                             AS recommended_fix,
      ROUND(s.cost_usd, 2)                                                   AS affected_cost_usd,
      ROUND(s.idle_cost_usd, 2)                                              AS estimated_waste_usd,
      ROUND(s.saving_usd * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2) AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      'Idle-hour cost x (1 - 30/setting); setting off: idle cost minus 30 min per active day'
                                                                             AS saving_basis,
      s.autoterm_min                                                         AS auto_termination_minutes,
      s.billed_hours,
      s.idle_hours
    FROM scored AS s
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = s.workspace_id
    ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC, affected_cost_usd DESC
  ) AS w1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 11  waste_idle_compute       Page 4 Waste               Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 2: clusters and SQL warehouses billed while idle or nearly idle.
    --
    -- Clusters (classic all-purpose, and classic job compute rolled up per job):
    --   idle hour = busiest node under 5 % CPU          -> waste = 100 % of that hour
    --   low hour  = average node under 20 % CPU (not idle) -> waste = 50 % of that hour
    --               (right-sizing estimate: half the nodes or a smaller node type)
    -- SQL warehouses: idle hour = billed hour in which no statement ran on the
    --   warehouse (system.query.history)                 -> waste = 100 % of that hour
    --   Only warehouses in this region's system.compute.warehouses are judged.
    -- Resources flagged by item 1 (auto-termination) or item 3 (auto-stop) are left
    -- out here, so a cost is counted once on the Recommendations page.
    -- Monthly saving = period waste x 30 / days in period.
    --
    -- Tables  system.compute.clusters, system.compute.node_timeline,
    --         system.compute.warehouses, system.query.history (regional),
    --         system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
    --         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    clusters_latest AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM (SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.workspace_id, c.cluster_id ORDER BY c.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.compute.clusters AS c) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    -- Same rule as dataset 10 (item 1); these clusters are reported there.
    autoterm_flagged AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id
      FROM clusters_latest
      WHERE cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
        AND delete_time IS NULL
        AND (auto_termination_minutes IS NULL OR auto_termination_minutes = 0 OR auto_termination_minutes > 60)
    ),
    warehouses_latest AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM (SELECT wh.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh.workspace_id, wh.warehouse_id ORDER BY wh.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.compute.warehouses AS wh) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    -- Same rule as dataset 12 (item 3); these warehouses are reported there.
    autostop_flagged AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id
      FROM warehouses_latest
      WHERE delete_time IS NULL
        AND (auto_stop_minutes = 0
             OR auto_stop_minutes > CASE WHEN warehouse_type = 'SERVERLESS' THEN 10 ELSE 45 END)
    ),
    jobs_latest AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, run_as_user_name, creator_user_name
      FROM (SELECT j.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.workspace_id, j.job_id ORDER BY j.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.lakeflow.jobs AS j) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    -- ---------- clusters ----------
    cluster_hour_cost AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id,
        usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
        CASE WHEN billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' THEN 'Job (classic job compute)' ELSE 'All-purpose cluster' END AS resource_type,
        CASE WHEN billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' THEN usage_metadata.job_id ELSE usage_metadata.cluster_id END AS resource_id,
        date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
        SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd
      FROM priced
      WHERE usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
        AND (billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE'
             OR (billing_origin_product = 'JOBS' AND usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL))
      GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
    ),
    node_hour AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, instance_id, date_trunc('HOUR', start_time) AS usage_hour,
             AVG(cpu_user_percent + cpu_system_percent) AS node_cpu_pct
      FROM system.compute.node_timeline
      WHERE start_time >= :start_date AND start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
      GROUP BY workspace_id, cluster_id, instance_id, date_trunc('HOUR', start_time)
    ),
    cluster_hour_cpu AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour,
             MAX(node_cpu_pct) AS max_node_cpu_pct,
             AVG(node_cpu_pct) AS avg_node_cpu_pct
      FROM node_hour
      GROUP BY workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour
    ),
    cluster_hours AS (
      SELECT
        h.*,
        c.avg_node_cpu_pct,
        CASE WHEN c.max_node_cpu_pct IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
             WHEN c.max_node_cpu_pct < 5     THEN 'idle'   -- EDIT HERE: idle CPU threshold (%)
             WHEN c.avg_node_cpu_pct < 20    THEN 'low'    -- EDIT HERE: low-activity CPU threshold (%)
             ELSE 'busy' END AS activity
      FROM cluster_hour_cost AS h
      LEFT JOIN cluster_hour_cpu AS c
        ON c.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND c.cluster_id = h.cluster_id AND c.usage_hour = h.usage_hour
      LEFT ANTI JOIN autoterm_flagged AS f
        ON h.resource_type = 'All-purpose cluster' AND f.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND f.cluster_id = h.cluster_id
    ),
    cluster_resources AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id,
        SUM(cost_usd)                                                         AS cost_usd,
        COUNT(*)                                                              AS billed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity = 'idle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                    AS idle_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity = 'low'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                    AS low_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity = 'idle' THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END)             AS idle_cost_usd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN activity = 'low'  THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END)             AS low_cost_usd,
        AVG(avg_node_cpu_pct)                                                 AS avg_cpu_pct
      FROM cluster_hours
      GROUP BY workspace_id, resource_type, resource_id
    ),
    -- ---------- SQL warehouses ----------
    warehouse_hour_cost AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
             date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
             SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
             max_by(identity_metadata.owned_by, usage_end_time) AS owned_by
      FROM priced
      WHERE usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id, date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time)
    ),
    warehouse_busy_hours AS (
      -- Every clock hour in which a statement was running on the warehouse.
      SELECT DISTINCT q.workspace_id, q.compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, busy_hour AS usage_hour
      FROM system.query.history AS q
      LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(date_trunc('HOUR', q.start_time),
                                    date_trunc('HOUR', COALESCE(q.end_time, q.update_time, q.start_time)),
                                    INTERVAL 1 HOUR)) hrs AS busy_hour
      WHERE q.compute.type = 'WAREHOUSE'
        AND q.start_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 1) AND q.start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
    ),
    warehouse_hours AS (
      -- Only warehouses this region can see: query.history is regional, so a
      -- warehouse of another region would look idle in every hour.
      SELECT h.*, b.usage_hour IS NULL AS is_idle
      FROM warehouse_hour_cost AS h
      JOIN warehouses_latest AS known
        ON known.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND known.warehouse_id = h.warehouse_id
      LEFT JOIN warehouse_busy_hours AS b
        ON b.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND b.warehouse_id = h.warehouse_id AND b.usage_hour = h.usage_hour
      LEFT ANTI JOIN autostop_flagged AS f
        ON f.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND f.warehouse_id = h.warehouse_id
    ),
    warehouse_resources AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, warehouse_id,
        max_by(owned_by, usage_hour)                                  AS owned_by,
        SUM(cost_usd)                                                 AS cost_usd,
        COUNT(*)                                                      AS billed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                      AS idle_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle THEN cost_usd ELSE 0 END)               AS idle_cost_usd
      FROM warehouse_hours
      GROUP BY workspace_id, warehouse_id
    ),
    -- ---------- one list ----------
    items AS (
      SELECT
        r.workspace_id, r.resource_type, r.resource_id,
        COALESCE(c.cluster_name, j.name, r.resource_id)                         AS resource_name,
        COALESCE(c.owned_by, j.run_as_user_name, j.creator_user_name)           AS owner,
        concat(CAST(r.idle_hours AS STRING), ' idle and ', CAST(r.low_hours AS STRING), ' low-CPU of ',
               CAST(r.billed_hours AS STRING), ' billed hours; average CPU ',
               COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(r.avg_cpu_pct, 1) AS STRING), 'n/a'), ' %')    AS finding,
        CASE WHEN r.resource_type = 'All-purpose cluster'
             THEN concat('Lower auto-termination to 15-30 min',
                         CASE WHEN r.low_hours > 0 THEN '; right-size: fewer workers or a smaller node type, autoscaling with a low min_workers' ELSE '' END,
                         '; run scheduled work as jobs on job compute')
             ELSE concat('Right-size the job cluster (fewer workers or a smaller node type, autoscaling)',
                         ' or move the job to serverless jobs compute')
        END                                                                       AS recommended_fix,
        r.cost_usd                                                                AS affected_cost_usd,
        r.idle_cost_usd + 0.5 * r.low_cost_usd                                    AS waste_usd,
        'Idle hours 100 % + low-CPU hours 50 % of their cost'                     AS saving_basis,
        r.billed_hours, r.idle_hours, r.low_hours
      FROM cluster_resources AS r
      LEFT JOIN clusters_latest AS c
        ON r.resource_type = 'All-purpose cluster' AND c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND c.cluster_id = r.resource_id
      LEFT JOIN jobs_latest AS j
        ON r.resource_type = 'Job (classic job compute)' AND j.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND j.job_id = r.resource_id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        r.workspace_id, 'SQL warehouse', r.warehouse_id,
        COALESCE(wl.warehouse_name, r.warehouse_id),
        r.owned_by,
        concat(CAST(r.idle_hours AS STRING), ' of ', CAST(r.billed_hours AS STRING),
               ' billed hours with no statement; auto-stop ',
               COALESCE(CAST(wl.auto_stop_minutes AS STRING), 'n/a'), ' min, clusters ',
               COALESCE(CAST(wl.min_clusters AS STRING), '?'), '-', COALESCE(CAST(wl.max_clusters AS STRING), '?')),
        concat('Keep min clusters at 1, merge little-used warehouses',
               CASE WHEN wl.warehouse_type = 'SERVERLESS' THEN ', consider auto-stop 5 min'
                    ELSE ', upgrade to serverless (auto-stop 10 min)' END),
        r.cost_usd,
        r.idle_cost_usd,
        'Billed hours with no statement: 100 % of their cost',
        r.billed_hours, r.idle_hours, CAST(0 AS BIGINT)
      FROM warehouse_resources AS r
      LEFT JOIN warehouses_latest AS wl
        ON wl.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND wl.warehouse_id = r.warehouse_id
    )
    SELECT
      '2 Idle or low-activity compute'                                         AS waste_item,
      i.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', i.workspace_id))         AS workspace_name,
      i.resource_type,
      i.resource_id,
      i.resource_name,
      i.owner,
      i.finding,
      i.recommended_fix,
      ROUND(i.affected_cost_usd, 2)                                            AS affected_cost_usd,
      ROUND(i.waste_usd, 2)                                                    AS estimated_waste_usd,
      ROUND(i.waste_usd * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2)    AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      i.saving_basis,
      i.billed_hours,
      i.idle_hours,
      i.low_hours
    FROM items AS i
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    WHERE i.waste_usd > 0
    ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC
  ) AS w2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 12  waste_warehouse_autostop  Page 4 Waste              Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 3: SQL warehouses (not deleted) with auto-stop off or above the
    -- Learn default "recommended for typical use":
    --   serverless   > 10 min   (UI minimum 5)
    --   pro, classic > 45 min   (minimum 10)
    -- The system table column is auto_stop_minutes; the Warehouses API field is
    -- auto_stop_mins.
    --
    -- Estimated waste = the larger of
    --   (a) tail estimate: stop events x (setting - target) / 60 x cost per uptime hour
    --       (uptime = STARTING to the next STOPPED, the Learn "most uptime" pattern)
    --   (b) idle billed hours: hours with no statement on the warehouse (query.history)
    -- The larger one is used, not the sum: both measure the same idle time.
    -- Auto-stop off (0) has no stop events, so (b) applies.
    -- Stop events include manual stops, so (a) is an upper bound.
    -- Monthly saving = period waste x 30 / days in period.
    --
    -- Tables  system.compute.warehouses, system.compute.warehouse_events,
    --         system.query.history (regional), system.billing.usage,
    --         system.billing.list_prices, system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    warehouses_latest AS (
      SELECT *
      FROM (SELECT wh.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wh.workspace_id, wh.warehouse_id ORDER BY wh.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.compute.warehouses AS wh) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    ),
    flagged AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, warehouse_type, warehouse_size,
        min_clusters, max_clusters, auto_stop_minutes,
        CASE WHEN warehouse_type = 'SERVERLESS' THEN 10 ELSE 45 END AS target_auto_stop_min   -- EDIT HERE
      FROM warehouses_latest
      WHERE delete_time IS NULL
        AND (auto_stop_minutes = 0
             OR auto_stop_minutes > CASE WHEN warehouse_type = 'SERVERLESS' THEN 10 ELSE 45 END)
    ),
    warehouse_hour_cost AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,
             date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
             SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
             max_by(identity_metadata.owned_by, usage_end_time) AS owned_by
      FROM priced
      WHERE usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id, date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time)
    ),
    warehouse_busy_hours AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT q.workspace_id, q.compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, busy_hour AS usage_hour
      FROM system.query.history AS q
      LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(date_trunc('HOUR', q.start_time),
                                    date_trunc('HOUR', COALESCE(q.end_time, q.update_time, q.start_time)),
                                    INTERVAL 1 HOUR)) hrs AS busy_hour
      WHERE q.compute.type = 'WAREHOUSE'
        AND q.start_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 1) AND q.start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
    ),
    cost_and_idle AS (
      SELECT
        h.workspace_id, h.warehouse_id,
        max_by(h.owned_by, h.usage_hour)                                    AS owned_by,
        SUM(h.cost_usd)                                                     AS cost_usd,
        COUNT(*)                                                            AS billed_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.usage_hour IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS idle_hours,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.usage_hour IS NULL THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END)      AS idle_cost_usd
      FROM warehouse_hour_cost AS h
      LEFT JOIN warehouse_busy_hours AS b
        ON b.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND b.warehouse_id = h.warehouse_id AND b.usage_hour = h.usage_hour
      GROUP BY h.workspace_id, h.warehouse_id
    ),
    events AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, warehouse_id, event_type, event_time,
        MIN(CASE WHEN event_type = 'STOPPED' THEN event_time END) OVER (
          PARTITION BY workspace_id, warehouse_id ORDER BY event_time
          ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)                 AS next_stopped_time
      FROM system.compute.warehouse_events
      WHERE event_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 7) AND event_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
    ),
    stops AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id, COUNT(*) AS stop_events
      FROM system.compute.warehouse_events
      WHERE event_type = 'STOPPED'
        AND event_time >= :start_date AND event_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
      GROUP BY workspace_id, warehouse_id
    ),
    uptime AS (
      -- STARTING -> next STOPPED (still running: now), clipped to the selected period.
      SELECT workspace_id, warehouse_id,
             SUM(GREATEST(0, timestampdiff(SECOND,
                   GREATEST(event_time, CAST(:start_date AS TIMESTAMP)),
                   LEAST(COALESCE(next_stopped_time, current_timestamp()), CAST(date_add(:end_date, 1) AS TIMESTAMP))
                 ))) / 3600.0 AS uptime_hours
      FROM events
      WHERE event_type = 'STARTING'
      GROUP BY workspace_id, warehouse_id
    ),
    scored AS (
      SELECT
        f.*,
        ci.owned_by,
        COALESCE(ci.cost_usd, 0)                                             AS cost_usd,
        COALESCE(ci.billed_hours, 0)                                         AS billed_hours,
        COALESCE(ci.idle_hours, 0)                                           AS idle_hours,
        COALESCE(ci.idle_cost_usd, 0)                                        AS idle_cost_usd,
        COALESCE(st.stop_events, 0)                                          AS stop_events,
        up.uptime_hours,
        CASE WHEN f.auto_stop_minutes > f.target_auto_stop_min AND up.uptime_hours > 0
             THEN COALESCE(st.stop_events, 0) * (f.auto_stop_minutes - f.target_auto_stop_min) / 60.0
                  * COALESCE(ci.cost_usd, 0) / up.uptime_hours
             ELSE 0 END                                                      AS tail_estimate_usd
      FROM flagged AS f
      LEFT JOIN cost_and_idle AS ci      ON ci.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND ci.warehouse_id = f.warehouse_id
      LEFT JOIN stops AS st              ON st.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND st.warehouse_id = f.warehouse_id
      LEFT JOIN uptime AS up             ON up.workspace_id = f.workspace_id AND up.warehouse_id = f.warehouse_id
    )
    SELECT
      '3 SQL warehouse auto-stop too high'                                   AS waste_item,
      s.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', s.workspace_id))       AS workspace_name,
      'SQL warehouse'                                                        AS resource_type,
      s.warehouse_id                                                         AS resource_id,
      s.warehouse_name                                                       AS resource_name,
      s.owned_by                                                             AS owner,
      concat(s.warehouse_type, ' ', COALESCE(s.warehouse_size, ''), ', auto-stop ',
             CASE WHEN s.auto_stop_minutes = 0 THEN 'off' ELSE concat(CAST(s.auto_stop_minutes AS STRING), ' min') END,
             '; ', CAST(s.stop_events AS STRING), ' stops, ', CAST(s.idle_hours AS STRING), ' idle billed hours')
                                                                             AS finding,
      CASE WHEN s.warehouse_type = 'SERVERLESS'
           THEN 'Set auto-stop to 10 min (UI minimum 5): SQL Warehouses > Edit > Auto stop, or auto_stop_mins in the Warehouses API'
           ELSE 'Upgrade to serverless (kebab menu > Upgrade to Serverless) with auto-stop 10 min; if it must stay pro/classic, set auto-stop to 45 min or lower (minimum 10)'
      END                                                                    AS recommended_fix,
      ROUND(s.cost_usd, 2)                                                   AS affected_cost_usd,
      ROUND(GREATEST(s.tail_estimate_usd, s.idle_cost_usd), 2)               AS estimated_waste_usd,
      ROUND(GREATEST(s.tail_estimate_usd, s.idle_cost_usd) * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2)
                                                                             AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      'Larger of: stops x (setting - target) x cost per uptime hour; cost of idle billed hours'
                                                                             AS saving_basis,
      s.warehouse_type,
      s.auto_stop_minutes,
      s.target_auto_stop_min,
      s.stop_events,
      ROUND(s.uptime_hours, 1)                                               AS uptime_hours,
      s.idle_hours
    FROM scored AS s
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = s.workspace_id
    ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC, affected_cost_usd DESC
  ) AS w3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 13  waste_jobs_on_all_purpose  Page 4 Waste             Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 4: jobs whose tasks ran on all-purpose compute instead of job compute.
    --
    -- Found with the Learn pattern "Find jobs running on all-purpose compute":
    -- job_task_run_timeline.compute_ids joined to clusters with cluster_source UI/API.
    -- Cost: billing.usage has no job_id for jobs on all-purpose compute, so the
    -- cluster's hourly cost is shared out by task minutes:
    --   job share of an hour = job task minutes / greatest(60, all task minutes in that hour)
    -- Learn: this "is not possible with 100% accuracy" on shared clusters; it is an estimate.
    -- Estimated waste = attributed cost x (1 - jobs price / all-purpose price), both
    -- from list_prices; the jobs SKU is the all-purpose SKU name with ALL_PURPOSE
    -- replaced by JOBS (for example PREMIUM_ALL_PURPOSE_COMPUTE -> PREMIUM_JOBS_COMPUTE).
    -- The VM cost is the same on both, so only the DBU price changes.
    -- Monthly saving = period waste x 30 / days in period.
    --
    -- Tables  system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline, system.lakeflow.jobs,
    --         system.compute.clusters (regional), system.billing.usage,
    --         system.billing.list_prices, system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    -- The same usage priced as job compute: ALL_PURPOSE -> JOBS in the SKU name.
    priced_as_jobs AS (
      SELECT
        pr.workspace_id,
        pr.usage_metadata.cluster_id                         AS cluster_id,
        date_trunc('HOUR', pr.usage_start_time)              AS usage_hour,
        SUM(pr.list_cost_usd)                                AS cost_usd,
        SUM(CAST(pr.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
            * CAST(COALESCE(j.pricing.effective_list.default, j.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE)) AS cost_at_jobs_price_usd,
        COUNT(j.sku_name) = COUNT(*)                         AS jobs_price_found
      FROM priced AS pr
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS j
        ON  j.sku_name = replace(pr.sku_name, 'ALL_PURPOSE', 'JOBS')
        AND j.cloud = pr.cloud
        AND j.usage_unit = pr.usage_unit
        AND j.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND pr.usage_end_time >= j.price_start_time
        AND (j.price_end_time IS NULL OR pr.usage_end_time < j.price_end_time)
      WHERE pr.billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE' AND pr.usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY pr.workspace_id, pr.usage_metadata.cluster_id, date_trunc('HOUR', pr.usage_start_time)
    ),
    all_purpose_clusters AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, cluster_name, owned_by
      FROM (SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.workspace_id, c.cluster_id ORDER BY c.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.compute.clusters AS c) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1 AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
    ),
    task_slices AS (
      SELECT t.workspace_id, t.job_id, t.run_id AS task_run_id, cid AS cluster_id,
             t.period_start_time, t.period_end_time
      FROM system.lakeflow.job_task_run_timeline AS t
      LATERAL VIEW explode(t.compute_ids) cids AS cid
      WHERE t.period_start_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 1) AND t.period_start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
    ),
    ap_task_hours AS (
      -- Split every task slice by clock hour (works for both timeline slicing logics).
      SELECT s.workspace_id, s.job_id, s.cluster_id, h AS usage_hour,
             GREATEST(0, timestampdiff(SECOND, GREATEST(s.period_start_time, h),
                                       LEAST(s.period_end_time, h + INTERVAL 1 HOUR))) / 60.0 AS task_minutes
      FROM task_slices AS s
      JOIN all_purpose_clusters AS c
        ON c.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND c.cluster_id = s.cluster_id
      LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(date_trunc('HOUR', s.period_start_time),
                                    date_trunc('HOUR', s.period_end_time), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)) hrs AS h
    ),
    cluster_hour_minutes AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour, SUM(task_minutes) AS all_task_minutes
      FROM ap_task_hours
      GROUP BY workspace_id, cluster_id, usage_hour
    ),
    job_hour_share AS (
      SELECT a.workspace_id, a.job_id, a.cluster_id, a.usage_hour,
             SUM(a.task_minutes) AS job_minutes,
             MAX(m.all_task_minutes) AS all_task_minutes
      FROM ap_task_hours AS a
      JOIN cluster_hour_minutes AS m
        ON m.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND m.cluster_id = a.cluster_id AND m.usage_hour = a.usage_hour
      GROUP BY a.workspace_id, a.job_id, a.cluster_id, a.usage_hour
    ),
    job_cost AS (
      SELECT
        s.workspace_id, s.job_id,
        SUM(s.job_minutes) / 60.0                                                         AS task_hours,
        SUM(pj.cost_usd * s.job_minutes / GREATEST(60.0, s.all_task_minutes))            AS attributed_cost_usd,
        SUM((pj.cost_usd - pj.cost_at_jobs_price_usd) * s.job_minutes / GREATEST(60.0, s.all_task_minutes)) AS premium_usd,
        BOOL_AND(pj.jobs_price_found)                                                     AS jobs_price_found,
        array_join(array_sort(collect_set(COALESCE(c.cluster_name, s.cluster_id))), ', ') AS clusters
      FROM job_hour_share AS s
      JOIN priced_as_jobs AS pj
        ON pj.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND pj.cluster_id = s.cluster_id AND pj.usage_hour = s.usage_hour
      LEFT JOIN all_purpose_clusters AS c
        ON c.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND c.cluster_id = s.cluster_id
      GROUP BY s.workspace_id, s.job_id
    ),
    jobs_latest AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, run_as_user_name, creator_user_name
      FROM (SELECT j.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.workspace_id, j.job_id ORDER BY j.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.lakeflow.jobs AS j) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT
      '4 Jobs on all-purpose compute'                                        AS waste_item,
      jc.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', jc.workspace_id))      AS workspace_name,
      'Job'                                                                  AS resource_type,
      jc.job_id                                                              AS resource_id,
      COALESCE(jl.name, jc.job_id)                                           AS resource_name,
      COALESCE(jl.run_as_user_name, jl.creator_user_name)                    AS owner,
      concat(CAST(ROUND(jc.task_hours, 1) AS STRING), ' task hours on all-purpose cluster(s): ', jc.clusters,
             CASE WHEN jc.jobs_price_found THEN '' ELSE ' (jobs SKU price not found for some hours)' END)
                                                                             AS finding,
      concat('Move the tasks to a job cluster (new job compute) or serverless jobs; block jobs on all-purpose compute ',
             'with a compute policy: "workload_type.clients.jobs": {"type": "fixed", "value": false}')
                                                                             AS recommended_fix,
      ROUND(jc.attributed_cost_usd, 2)                                       AS affected_cost_usd,
      ROUND(COALESCE(jc.premium_usd, 0), 2)                                  AS estimated_waste_usd,
      ROUND(COALESCE(jc.premium_usd, 0) * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2)
                                                                             AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      'Attributed all-purpose cost minus the same DBUs at the jobs compute list price'
                                                                             AS saving_basis,
      ROUND(jc.task_hours, 1)                                                AS task_hours,
      jc.clusters
    FROM job_cost AS jc
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest AS jl ON jl.workspace_id = jc.workspace_id AND jl.job_id = jc.job_id
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = jc.workspace_id
    ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC
  ) AS w4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 14  unattributed_spend       Page 4 Waste               Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 5: spend without a cost-center tag or an owner tag, per
    -- workspace and compute category. This is unmonitored spend, not waste:
    -- estimated_waste_usd and the saving are 0; affected_cost_usd is the USD at risk.
    --
    -- Tag keys as in dataset 09 (case-insensitive, letters and digits only).
    --   EDIT HERE if PEST uses other keys: the two arrays in tag_keys below.
    --
    -- Tables  system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
    --         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH tag_keys AS (
      SELECT
        array('costcenter', 'costcentre')                     AS cost_center_keys,  -- EDIT HERE
        array('owner', 'businessowner', 'technicalowner')     AS owner_keys         -- EDIT HERE
    ),
    priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    tagged AS (
      SELECT
        p.workspace_id,
        p.list_cost_usd,
        CASE
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE'                                          THEN 'All-purpose compute (classic)'
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product IN ('JOBS', 'DLT') AND COALESCE(p.product_features.is_serverless, FALSE) THEN 'Serverless jobs and pipelines'
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product IN ('JOBS', 'DLT')                                       THEN 'Classic jobs and pipelines'
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'SQL'                                                  THEN 'SQL warehouses'
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'INTERACTIVE'                                          THEN 'Serverless notebooks'
          WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'MODEL_SERVING'                                        THEN 'Model serving'
          ELSE concat('Other: ', COALESCE(p.billing_origin_product, 'unknown'))
        END AS compute_category,
        NULLIF(trim(try_element_at(map_values(map_filter(p.custom_tags,
          (k, v) -> array_contains(t.cost_center_keys, lower(regexp_replace(k, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', ''))))), 1)), '') AS cost_center,
        NULLIF(trim(try_element_at(map_values(map_filter(p.custom_tags,
          (k, v) -> array_contains(t.owner_keys, lower(regexp_replace(k, '[^A-Za-z0-9]', ''))))), 1)), '')       AS owner_tag
      FROM priced AS p
      CROSS JOIN tag_keys AS t
    ),
    by_category AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id,
        compute_category,
        SUM(list_cost_usd)                                                              AS cost_usd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cost_center IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END)                AS no_cost_center_usd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN owner_tag  IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END)                 AS no_owner_usd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cost_center IS NULL OR owner_tag IS NULL THEN list_cost_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unattributed_usd
      FROM tagged
      GROUP BY workspace_id, compute_category
    )
    SELECT
      '5 Unattributed spend (no cost-center or owner tag)'                   AS waste_item,
      b.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name,
               CASE WHEN b.workspace_id IS NULL THEN '(account level)'
                    ELSE concat('workspace ', b.workspace_id) END)            AS workspace_name,
      'Usage category'                                                       AS resource_type,
      concat(COALESCE(b.workspace_id, 'account'), ':', b.compute_category)   AS resource_id,
      b.compute_category                                                     AS resource_name,
      CAST(NULL AS STRING)                                                   AS owner,
      concat(CAST(ROUND(try_divide(b.no_cost_center_usd, b.cost_usd) * 100, 0) AS STRING), ' % without cost-center tag, ',
             CAST(ROUND(try_divide(b.no_owner_usd, b.cost_usd) * 100, 0) AS STRING), ' % without owner tag')
                                                                             AS finding,
      CASE b.compute_category
        WHEN 'All-purpose compute (classic)'  THEN 'Make tags mandatory in every compute policy: "custom_tags.CostCenter": {"type": "allowlist", "values": [...]} and "custom_tags.Owner": {"type": "unlimited"}'
        WHEN 'Classic jobs and pipelines'     THEN 'Use a job-only compute policy with the same mandatory custom_tags.CostCenter and custom_tags.Owner rules; add job tags'
        WHEN 'Serverless jobs and pipelines'  THEN 'Assign a serverless usage policy with CostCenter and Owner tags to the jobs and pipelines'
        WHEN 'Serverless notebooks'           THEN 'Assign a serverless usage policy with CostCenter and Owner tags to the users or groups'
        WHEN 'SQL warehouses'                 THEN 'Add CostCenter and Owner tags on each SQL warehouse (Edit > Advanced options > Tags)'
        WHEN 'Model serving'                  THEN 'Add CostCenter and Owner tags on each serving endpoint or a serverless usage policy'
        ELSE 'Tag the resource where the product supports tags, or use a serverless usage policy'
      END                                                                    AS recommended_fix,
      ROUND(b.unattributed_usd, 2)                                           AS affected_cost_usd,
      CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS estimated_waste_usd,
      CAST(0 AS DOUBLE)                                                      AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      'Visibility item: no direct saving; enables chargeback and owner follow-up'
                                                                             AS saving_basis,
      ROUND(b.cost_usd, 2)                                                   AS category_cost_usd,
      ROUND(b.no_cost_center_usd, 2)                                         AS no_cost_center_usd,
      ROUND(b.no_owner_usd, 2)                                               AS no_owner_usd
    FROM by_category AS b
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = b.workspace_id
    WHERE b.unattributed_usd > 0
    ORDER BY affected_cost_usd DESC
  ) AS w5
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    waste_item,
    workspace_id,
    workspace_name,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    resource_name,
    owner,
    finding,
    recommended_fix,
    affected_cost_usd,
    estimated_waste_usd,
    estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
    saving_basis
  FROM (
    -- =============================================================================
    -- Dataset 15  waste_job_runs           Page 4 Waste               Visual: table (+ counter)
    -- Waste item 6: failed or repaired job runs, and long-running job runs, per job.
    --
    -- Run cost = billing.usage joined on usage_metadata.job_id / job_run_id (Learn:
    -- "Calculate cost per job run"). Covers job compute and serverless jobs; jobs
    -- on all-purpose compute have no job_run_id in billing (see item 4).
    -- Run facts from job_run_timeline (runs over an hour have several rows;
    -- result_state is set only on the row that ends the run; a repaired run has
    -- more than one row with a result_state - the Learn "retried job runs" pattern).
    --   6a Failed or repaired runs:
    --      final state FAILED / ERROR / TIMED_OUT -> waste = whole run cost
    --      repaired, then SUCCEEDED               -> waste = cost up to the last failure
    --   6b Long-running runs (successful, not repaired):
    --      run minutes > 2 x the job's median AND at least 30 minutes over it,
    --      job with at least 3 such runs          -> waste = run cost - median run cost
    -- Monthly saving = period waste x 30 / days in period.
    --
    -- Tables  system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline, system.lakeflow.jobs (regional),
    --         system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices,
    --         system.access.workspaces_latest (global).
    -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
    -- =============================================================================
    WITH priced AS (
      -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
      SELECT
        u.*,
        CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
          * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
      FROM system.billing.usage AS u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
        ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
        AND p.cloud = u.cloud
        AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
        AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
        AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
        AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
      WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    ),
    run_hour_cost AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id AS run_id,
             date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time) AS usage_hour,
             SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
             max_by(identity_metadata.run_as, usage_end_time) AS run_as
      FROM priced
      WHERE billing_origin_product = 'JOBS'
        AND usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL AND usage_metadata.job_run_id IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY workspace_id, usage_metadata.job_id, usage_metadata.job_run_id, date_trunc('HOUR', usage_start_time)
    ),
    runs AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, job_id, run_id,
        SUM(timestampdiff(SECOND, period_start_time, period_end_time)) / 60.0                AS run_minutes,
        COUNT(result_state)                                                                   AS terminal_rows,
        max_by(result_state, CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END)     AS final_state,
        max_by(termination_code, CASE WHEN result_state IS NOT NULL THEN period_end_time END) AS final_termination_code,
        MAX(CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN period_end_time END) AS last_failure_end,
        max_by(termination_code,
               CASE WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT') THEN period_end_time END) AS failure_termination_code
      FROM system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
      WHERE period_start_time >= date_sub(:start_date, 1) AND period_start_time < date_add(:end_date, 1)
      GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id, run_id
    ),
    run_level AS (
      SELECT
        r.*,
        c.cost_usd,
        c.cost_until_last_failure_usd,
        c.run_as,
        CASE WHEN r.final_state IN ('FAILED', 'ERROR', 'TIMED_OUT')       THEN 'failed'
             WHEN r.final_state = 'SUCCEEDED' AND r.last_failure_end IS NOT NULL THEN 'repaired'
             WHEN r.final_state = 'SUCCEEDED'                              THEN 'succeeded'
             ELSE 'other' END                                               AS outcome
      FROM runs AS r
      JOIN (
        SELECT h.workspace_id, h.job_id, h.run_id,
               SUM(h.cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
               SUM(CASE WHEN h.usage_hour <= date_trunc('HOUR', r2.last_failure_end) THEN h.cost_usd ELSE 0 END)
                                                                            AS cost_until_last_failure_usd,
               max_by(h.run_as, h.usage_hour) AS run_as
        FROM run_hour_cost AS h
        JOIN runs AS r2 ON r2.workspace_id = h.workspace_id AND r2.job_id = h.job_id AND r2.run_id = h.run_id
        GROUP BY h.workspace_id, h.job_id, h.run_id
      ) AS c
        ON c.workspace_id = r.workspace_id AND c.job_id = r.job_id AND c.run_id = r.run_id
    ),
    job_baseline AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, job_id,
             percentile_approx(run_minutes, 0.5) AS median_minutes,
             percentile_approx(cost_usd, 0.5)    AS median_cost_usd,
             COUNT(*)                            AS clean_runs
      FROM run_level
      WHERE outcome = 'succeeded'
      GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id
    ),
    issues AS (
      SELECT
        workspace_id, job_id,
        '6a Failed or repaired job runs'                                    AS waste_item,
        COUNT(*)                                                            AS affected_runs,
        SUM(cost_usd)                                                       AS affected_cost_usd,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'failed' THEN cost_usd ELSE cost_until_last_failure_usd END) AS waste_usd,
        concat(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' failed, ',
               CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'repaired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING), ' repaired; codes: ',
               COALESCE(array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(failure_termination_code)), 1, 3), ', '), 'n/a'))
                                                                            AS finding,
        'Fix the root cause shown by the termination codes; set task retries with a retry interval, a job timeout and a failure notification (job > Duration and timeouts / Notifications)'
                                                                            AS recommended_fix,
        'Failed run: whole run cost; repaired run: cost up to the last failure'
                                                                            AS saving_basis,
        max_by(run_as, cost_usd)                                            AS run_as
      FROM run_level
      WHERE outcome IN ('failed', 'repaired')
      GROUP BY workspace_id, job_id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        rl.workspace_id, rl.job_id,
        '6b Long-running job runs',
        COUNT(*),
        SUM(rl.cost_usd),
        SUM(GREATEST(rl.cost_usd - b.median_cost_usd, 0)),
        concat(CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING), ' runs over 2x the median of ',
               CAST(ROUND(MAX(b.median_minutes), 0) AS STRING), ' min; longest ',
               CAST(ROUND(MAX(rl.run_minutes), 0) AS STRING), ' min'),
        'Set a job timeout and a duration warning threshold; check data skew, input growth and cluster size',
        'Run cost above the job''s median run cost',
        max_by(rl.run_as, rl.cost_usd)
      FROM run_level AS rl
      JOIN job_baseline AS b ON b.workspace_id = rl.workspace_id AND b.job_id = rl.job_id
      WHERE rl.outcome = 'succeeded'
        AND b.clean_runs >= 3                                      -- EDIT HERE: minimum runs for a baseline
        AND rl.run_minutes > 2 * b.median_minutes                  -- EDIT HERE: x median
        AND rl.run_minutes - b.median_minutes >= 30                -- EDIT HERE: minutes over median
      GROUP BY rl.workspace_id, rl.job_id
    ),
    jobs_latest AS (
      SELECT workspace_id, job_id, name, run_as_user_name, creator_user_name
      FROM (SELECT j.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.workspace_id, j.job_id ORDER BY j.change_time DESC) AS rn
            FROM system.lakeflow.jobs AS j) AS t
      WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT
      i.waste_item,
      i.workspace_id,
      COALESCE(w.workspace_name, concat('workspace ', i.workspace_id))       AS workspace_name,
      'Job'                                                                  AS resource_type,
      i.job_id                                                               AS resource_id,
      COALESCE(jl.name, i.job_id)                                            AS resource_name,
      COALESCE(jl.run_as_user_name, i.run_as, jl.creator_user_name)          AS owner,
      i.finding,
      i.recommended_fix,
      ROUND(i.affected_cost_usd, 2)                                          AS affected_cost_usd,
      ROUND(i.waste_usd, 2)                                                  AS estimated_waste_usd,
      ROUND(i.waste_usd * 30.0 / (datediff(:end_date, :start_date) + 1), 2)  AS estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
      i.saving_basis,
      i.affected_runs
    FROM issues AS i
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest AS jl ON jl.workspace_id = i.workspace_id AND jl.job_id = i.job_id
    LEFT JOIN system.access.workspaces_latest AS w ON w.workspace_id = i.workspace_id
    WHERE i.waste_usd > 0
    ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC
  ) AS w6
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY estimated_monthly_saving_usd DESC, affected_cost_usd DESC) AS priority,
  waste_item,
  workspace_id,
  workspace_name,
  resource_type,
  resource_id,
  resource_name,
  owner,
  finding,
  recommended_fix,
  affected_cost_usd,
  estimated_waste_usd,
  estimated_monthly_saving_usd,
  saving_basis
FROM all_items
ORDER BY priority;

-- =============================================================================
-- Dataset 17  top_identities           Page 3 Cost by user        Visual: bar
-- GENERATED by build_dashboard.py from dataset 08: the top 20 identities only,
-- so the bar chart stays readable. Do not edit; edit 08_cost_by_identity.sql.
-- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
-- =============================================================================
SELECT *
FROM (
  -- =============================================================================
  -- Dataset 08  cost_by_identity         Page 3 Cost by user        Visual: bar + table
  -- Top users and service principals by cost, ranked.
  --
  -- Attribution (Learn, identity_metadata reference):
  --   all-purpose compute -> system.compute.clusters.owned_by (run_as there is the
  --                          identity that CREATED the cluster, not its owner);
  --   everything else     -> identity_metadata.run_as (jobs, serverless, pipelines),
  --                          then owned_by (SQL warehouse usage only), then
  --                          created_by (Apps, Knowledge Assistant, Supervisor Agent).
  --   Nothing found       -> '(unattributed)'.
  -- identity_type: '@' = user; a GUID = service principal application ID;
  -- anything else = group or system identity.
  --
  -- Tables  system.billing.usage, system.billing.list_prices (global),
  --         system.compute.clusters (regional; latest owner per cluster).
  -- Params  :start_date, :end_date (DATE).
  -- =============================================================================
  WITH priced AS (
    -- One row per usage record with its USD list cost (Learn: "Join the pricing with usage tables").
    SELECT
      u.*,
      CAST(u.usage_quantity AS DOUBLE)
        * CAST(COALESCE(p.pricing.effective_list.default, p.pricing.default) AS DOUBLE) AS list_cost_usd
    FROM system.billing.usage AS u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices AS p
      ON  p.sku_name = u.sku_name
      AND p.cloud = u.cloud
      AND p.usage_unit = u.usage_unit
      AND p.currency_code = 'USD'
      AND u.usage_end_time >= p.price_start_time
      AND (p.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_end_time < p.price_end_time)
    WHERE u.usage_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
  ),
  clusters_latest AS (
    SELECT workspace_id, cluster_id, owned_by
    FROM (SELECT c.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.workspace_id, c.cluster_id ORDER BY c.change_time DESC) AS rn
          FROM system.compute.clusters AS c) AS t
    WHERE rn = 1
  ),
  attributed AS (
    SELECT
      p.workspace_id,
      p.billing_origin_product,
      p.list_cost_usd,
      p.usage_quantity,
      p.usage_unit,
      CASE WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE' AND c.owned_by IS NOT NULL THEN c.owned_by
           ELSE COALESCE(p.identity_metadata.run_as, p.identity_metadata.owned_by,
                         p.identity_metadata.created_by, c.owned_by)
      END AS identity,
      CASE WHEN p.billing_origin_product = 'ALL_PURPOSE' AND c.owned_by IS NOT NULL THEN 'cluster owner'
           WHEN p.identity_metadata.run_as     IS NOT NULL THEN 'run_as'
           WHEN p.identity_metadata.owned_by   IS NOT NULL THEN 'warehouse owner'
           WHEN p.identity_metadata.created_by IS NOT NULL THEN 'created_by'
           WHEN c.owned_by                     IS NOT NULL THEN 'cluster owner'
           ELSE 'none'
      END AS attribution_source
    FROM priced AS p
    LEFT JOIN clusters_latest AS c
      ON c.workspace_id = p.workspace_id
     AND c.cluster_id = p.usage_metadata.cluster_id
  ),
  by_identity_product AS (
    SELECT identity, billing_origin_product, SUM(list_cost_usd) AS cost_usd
    FROM attributed
    GROUP BY identity, billing_origin_product
  ),
  by_identity AS (
    SELECT
      a.identity,
      SUM(a.list_cost_usd)                                          AS cost_usd,
      SUM(CASE WHEN a.usage_unit = 'DBU' THEN a.usage_quantity END) AS dbus,
      COUNT(DISTINCT a.workspace_id)                                AS workspaces,
      array_join(array_sort(collect_set(a.attribution_source)), ', ') AS attribution_sources
    FROM attributed AS a
    GROUP BY a.identity
  ),
  top_product AS (
    SELECT identity, max_by(billing_origin_product, cost_usd) AS top_product
    FROM by_identity_product
    GROUP BY identity
  )
  SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(b.cost_usd, 0) DESC)                AS cost_rank,
    COALESCE(b.identity, '(unattributed)')                             AS identity,
    CASE WHEN b.identity IS NULL THEN 'Unattributed'
         WHEN b.identity LIKE '%@%' THEN 'User'
         WHEN b.identity RLIKE '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
              THEN 'Service principal'
         ELSE 'Group or system'
    END                                                                AS identity_type,
    ROUND(b.cost_usd, 2)                                               AS cost_usd,
    ROUND(CAST(b.dbus AS DOUBLE), 1)                                   AS dbus,
    b.workspaces,
    tp.top_product,
    b.attribution_sources,
    ROUND(try_divide(b.cost_usd, SUM(b.cost_usd) OVER ()) * 100, 1)    AS share_of_total_pct
  FROM by_identity AS b
  LEFT JOIN top_product AS tp ON tp.identity <=> b.identity
  ORDER BY cost_rank
) AS ranked
WHERE cost_rank <= 20
ORDER BY cost_rank;
